name: Dario Oh
life: “I still remember eating a sandwich halfway through a modeling job.” People around the bank steps know Dario by a small Saturday habit. Dario takes a few minutes to read the public notices, especially the ones written in a hurry.
voice: I was her model. I held a sandwich in the hand that looks so noble now.
appearance: Dario is easy to recognize by soft white hair brushed sideways and a round face with a pronounced chin. Usually dressed in a narrow-striped sweater with a little coil of soft measuring tape, Dario touches a knuckle to the chin when searching for a word when listening.
personality: Dario feels a room through sound. A door slammed in high spirits can produce the same instant startle as an angry one, and it takes a little while to hear what actually follows.
agenda: To tell visitors what the model actually held.
family: Mia Frost is Dario’s first cousin once removed. Dario saves a place. Mia chooses whether to use it. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *First shift back*, Mia says, “I stopped sending messages after the first month.”
connections: Astrid Olsen (mural painter). The model and the original painter finally explain the sandwich.

reactions.response: Dario walks the observers to the angle the model chose.

reactions.situation: The last bus leaves while an elderly stranger is still crossing toward it
reactions.response: Dario asks the stranger who will be expecting them, then helps find a way to tell that person.
